name: Local AI
author: 0xSero
description: The model validated for your GPU, one click, and every coding agent on it. 81 validated recipes across 36 cards: NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50, RTX Ada, RTX Pro Blackwell, Intel Arc Pro B70 and AMD ROCm. Weights verified against the pinned revision, the engine on a private network behind a keyed gateway on loopback, one polkit prompt per start. Open claude, codex, pi, omp, opencode, crush, grok, copilot, hermes, ori, agy, muse or cursor on a running model without touching your own config.
